topic: Updating road links and map data
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the process of updating road links and map data, particularly concerning OSM updates. It was noted that in some regions (like Brazil), only initial loading occurs without automatic updates.

Regarding updates, one participant mentioned that recalculation happens every three months when a request for roads is made, refreshing the square if it is older than three months. This process involves requesting data for a 500x500 meter square rather than loading an entire country's worth of data.

It was clarified that this automatic update only occurs during a road recalculation request and does not automatically track OSM changes across the board. Attempts to force recalculations were cautioned against, as they could prevent the reconstruction of historical data.
decisions: Recalculation for roads is triggered every three months when requested.
